summary: Global Mofy AI Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a previously announced self-underwritten registered direct offering, not a special situation. On November 6, 2026 the Cayman-incorporated issuer sold 45,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.22 per share under an October 30, 2026 securities purchase agreement with certain investors, raising approximately US$9.9 million gross before expenses. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition beyond completion was disclosed. The placement is registered by reference to two Form F-3 shelf registrations. Watch dilution and resale overhang from the new shares.
